task: Review and verify the newly added metadata-only relay status integration: workflow publishes brain-app/relay-status.json, and the dashboard loads it. Identify any remaining correctness, privacy, or reliability issue and give the single highest-value next implementation step. prior_packet: Current repository state (2026-10-20): A push to brain-app/relay-request.json triggers the free-tier relay automatically. Latest live run confirmed all three providers succeeded in sequence: Groq, Gemini, OpenRouter (OpenRouter free model dots-studio/dots-3-note-preview:free). I added a metadata-only publication step to .github/workflows/brain-app-relay.yml: it writes run ID/url, outcome, successful/total turns, provider/model names and error categories to brain-app/relay-status.json, excluding prompts, task content, model responses and API keys. The dashboard index now has a Latest relay run panel, and app.js fetches ./relay-status.json, displays worker outcomes, and links to the GitHub run. GitHub Actions validation passed after these changes. This next live run should verify the status-publication step and same-origin dashboard fetch. Strict $0 upfront/free-tier only. Do not publish content or change external accounts.
